description: Source code for NodeServiceManager, a utility for managing node services including starting and stopping them, executing commands, parsing JSON responses, and logging errors within an application. It also contains internal helper structures and functions related to command execution and JSON parsing.

classes.name: CommandResult
classes.description: Holds the result of executing a command, including success status, payload data, message, and parsed JSON content.

classes.name: ParsedServiceJson
classes.description: Structures the JSON data parsed from service responses, including status text, result flags, messages, errors, and hints.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the node service, returning an error message if it fails.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the node service, returning an error message if it fails.
